events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the sponsor confirm the scope, team and calendar for the diagnostic?
agenda: Confirm the scope: patient waiting times at the three hospitals
Align on team roles and how the sponsor will steer the work
Confirm the calendar: check-in in week 4, final readout in week 6

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Review baseline and pathway delay findings
events.decision: Which pathway steps should the causes analysis examine in most detail?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline for the three hospitals
Review patient pathway delays by step and hospital
Decide which pathway steps the causes analysis examines in most detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present the diagnostic for sponsor approval
events.decision: Does the sponsor approve the waiting-time diagnostic as the final result?
agenda: Present the waiting-time diagnostic final readout
Review the baseline, pathway delays and causes of delay by hospital
Decide on approval of the diagnostic as the final result
